title: Strict input refuses an undeclared field, a second document, an anchor, a merge key and a duplicate key
given: One service declaration with a correct head.
when: The text adds an unknown field, a second document, an anchor, a merge key, a non-string key or a duplicate collection key.
then: The parser refuses the declaration and names the file and the line.

title: Strict input holds the size limit and the nesting limit
given: A declaration larger than 4 MiB, and a declaration with 130 nesting levels.
when: The parser reads each one.
then: The parser refuses both and reports the byte limit and the nesting limit.

title: An archetype that the registry does not hold is refused
given: A project with a loaded registry.
when: The declaration names an archetype that the registry does not hold.
then: Checking reports an archetype fault that names the archetype.

title: Two entities with one name are refused
given: A valid project.
when: The declaration declares the entity Widget two times.
then: Checking reports that the entity is defined more than one time.

title: Two fields with one name in one entity are refused
given: A valid project.
when: One entity declares the field label two times.
then: Checking reports a duplicate field name.

title: A constraint that does not suit the field type is refused
given: A valid project.
when: A field puts a string constraint on a number, or a number constraint on a string, or enum values on another type.
then: Checking reports one fault for each constraint that does not suit the type.

title: Two collections with one name are refused
given: A valid project.
when: The declaration holds two collections with the same name.
then: Checking reports a duplicate collection name.

title: A collection that names an entity the declaration does not declare is refused
given: A valid project.
when: A collection names an entity that the declaration does not declare.
then: Checking reports that the entity is not defined.

title: A slot binding to a slot that no component declares is refused
given: A project whose components declare a known set of slots.
when: A slot binding names a slot outside that set.
then: Checking refuses the binding and names the available slots.

title: A slot binding to a collection the declaration does not declare is refused
given: A valid project with one collection.
when: A slot binding names another collection.
then: Checking refuses the binding and names the available collections.

title: A slot binding with no operator is refused
given: A valid project with one slot.
when: The slot binding holds no gate, chain or fan-out.
then: Checking refuses the binding and names the three operators.

title: A slot binding with more than one operator is refused
given: A valid project with one slot.
when: The slot binding holds a gate, a chain and a fan-out together.
then: Checking refuses the binding and requires one operator.

title: A binding to a slot that no generator invokes is refused
given: A component declares the slot resolve_field, and no generator in the build consumes it.
when: The declaration binds a fill to that slot.
then: Checking reports that no resolved generator consumes the slot.

title: One refusal reports every semantic fault together
given: A declaration with four separate faults.
when: Checking runs one time.
then: The result holds a fault for each one of the four, and not the first fault alone.

title: An unknown setting, a wrong value type and an inactive component are refused
given: A component that declares one string setting.
when: The declaration misspells the setting, gives it a number, names a component that is not active, or gives a value in place of a map.
then: Checking refuses each one, and generation refuses it with the same config fault.

title: A setting value must suit its declared type and its value set
given: A setting schema for each supported type, with lists and nested objects.
when: A value of the wrong type, a value outside the value set, a null value or an unknown nested key is checked.
then: The check reports a fault and names the path and the expected type.

title: Scaffolding refuses an existing path and changes no existing file
given: A project that already holds service.yaml, the registry config, the .stego directory or the fills directory, as a file, a directory or a link.
when: Scaffolding runs.
then: Scaffolding fails. The existing file keeps its content, and no file outside the project changes.

title: Generation uses the result of the one checking stage
given: A declaration with a semantic fault.
when: The validate command runs, then the plan runs.
then: The plan fails with the same fault text that checking reports. No generator runs.

title: Checking writes no file when it refuses a declaration
given: A project with a faulty declaration, an existing output file and an existing state record.
when: The validate, plan and apply commands each run.
then: Each command fails. The output file and the state record keep their content, and no go.mod appears.

title: Recovery completes an interrupted apply, so output and record always agree
given: A project with applied output and a new plan.
when: Apply fails at each journal point in turn, and recover runs.
then: Plan and drift refuse until recovery runs. After recovery the output matches the state record and no drift remains.

title: Drift detection fails when a generated file no longer matches its recorded hash
given: A project with applied output and recorded file hashes.
when: A generated file is edited by hand and drift detection runs.
then: The result names the modified file and reports drift.

title: A state record whose input manifest disagrees with it is refused
given: An applied state record with an input manifest.
when: The service hash or the registry reference in the manifest differs from the applied value.
then: State validation refuses the record.

title: Apply refuses a plan whose registry digest differs from the live registry
given: A plan from a loaded registry.
when: The registry content digest in the plan state is replaced and apply runs.
then: Apply fails with a registry error and writes no output.

title: A changed component generator shows as an update in the next plan
given: A project applied from one component generator output.
when: The component produces new content and plan runs again.
then: The plan marks the generated file as an update.

title: A registry change that does not affect output leaves every generated file unchanged
given: A project with applied output and a recorded registry digest.
when: A comment is added to a component declaration and apply runs.
then: The state record gains the new registry digest. Every generated file stays unchanged.

title: A new generation run restores the generated output without a hand edit
given: A project with applied output.
when: A generated file is edited by hand, then plan and apply run.
then: The plan names the file as an update. Apply restores the generated content and leaves no drift.

title: Qualification fails when the release tag does not point at the source commit
given: A qualified source commit and a published release tag.
when: The tag points at another commit and release verification runs.
then: Qualification fails.

title: Qualification fails when a required CI job has no success conclusion
given: A complete set of CI runs at the source commit.
when: One required checks job is absent from the job list.
then: Qualification fails.

title: Release verification cross-checks every published asset digest and the evidence notes
given: A published immutable release at the qualified commit.
when: Qualification runs with --verify-release.
then: It installs the release through the consumer path. It reports the asset digests and confirms that the notes hold the run and the compiler digest.

title: Installation refuses a platform other than Linux amd64 before any download
given: An installation request for a published release.
when: The machine reports aarch64, or the revision is not a full commit, or the result directory exists.
then: Installation fails and makes no API call.

title: Installation verifies both signatures before it puts the binary in place
given: A published release with four assets.
when: Installation downloads and verifies the assets.
then: The compiler and the build record are both authenticated while the result directory does not yet exist. The published bytes then match the downloaded bytes.

title: The version command reports the current build record
given: A built stego binary.
when: The version command runs with --json.
then: The record in the output equals the current build identity.

title: Apply writes the current build identity into the service state record
given: A project ready for apply.
when: Apply runs, and then a changed build record is offered in the plan.
then: The state record holds the current build identity. Apply refuses a substituted record and leaves the state unchanged.
